All the alloys rupture in a brittle quasi-cleavage mode, and the lower V addition (3 at.%) improves the fracture toughness while the higher V addition (5 and 10 at.%) degrades it.

According to EDS analysis results (Table 2), the increase in microhardness of silicide is maybe attributed to the increased concentrations of V and Ti in silicide, having an effect of solid solution strengthening [32].
It is therefore reasonably to infer that the decreased microhardness of Nbss is also attributed to the solid solution softening from V addition.
